Qwen 3.8 27B i get 34 tp/s on rtx 3090 llama.ccp
Discussion

What kind of speeds are you guys getting ? Ive tried Unsloth studio on win11 and then switched to my linux os and trying llama.ccp right now , its about 34 - 36 tokens a second , seems rather slow as i remember i was getting 50-60 on 3.6 27b.
I have not tried any speculative decoding yet , and the quant im using is IQ4 NL , KV at Q8

But yeah that thing is amazing so far , very impressed so far and it truly feels next gen not just a improvement

oathcunt
•
8d ago

I’m running the model on a Tesla V100 32gb PCIe-x16 (this card has about 8% less bandwidth than the 3090, and an older architecture). The card is averaging around 42 tok/s decode speeds, these are my llama.cpp flags:

-m Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf
--mmproj mmproj-BF16.gguf
--alias qwen-dense-extreme

-ngl 99
--device CUDA0
--split-mode layer
--tensor-split 1
--main-gpu 0

-c 131072
-fa on
--cache-type-k f16
--cache-type-v f16
--jinja
--no-mmproj-offload
--cache-prompt
--cache-ram 4096

--reasoning on
--reasoning-budget 16384
--reasoning-format deepseek

--spec-type draft-mtp
--spec-draft-n-max 2
--spec-draft-n-min 0

--host <private-endpoint>
--port 8096
-np 1
--threads 22
--threads-batch 22
--batch-size 4096
--ubatch-size 2048
--timeout 3600

UnorderedPizza
•
8d ago

Are you using split tensors on llama.cpp?

kepardi99
•
8d ago

split tensor does not seem to work with Qwen3.8 27b with 2x P100, I was using tensor split with Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf  as it did help with more tokens. My current spell below. MTP helped 10->12tokens per sec. Also for some reason 'flash-attn off' is needed, was able to keep it on: Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B-UD-Q1_0-00001-of-00010.gguf

GGML_CUDA_P2P=1 ./llama-server \

--model /data2/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf \

--split-mode layer \

--tensor-split 1,1 \

-ngl 99 \

-c 22000 \

-t 12 \

-tb 16 \

--flash-attn off \

--kv-unified \

--batch-size 128 \

--ubatch-size 32 \

--parallel 1 \

--spec-type draft-mtp \

--spec-draft-ngl all \

--spec-draft-cpu-moe \

--no-mmap \

--temp 1.0 \

--top-p 0.95 \

--top-k 20 \

--min-p 0.0 \

--port 8080 --host 0.0.0.0 \

-lv 3
